mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wms_env_monitor_data (collect_id, device_id, device_type, online, collect_time, device_value, alar_status, receive_time) VALUES
( #{item.collectId}, #{item.deviceId}, #{item.deviceType}, #{item.online}, #{item.collectTime}, #{item.deviceValue}, #{item.alarStatus}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT t.device_id AS "deviceId", t.collect_id AS "collectId", t.device_type AS "deviceType", t.online, t.collect_time AS "collectTime", t.device_value AS "deviceValue", t.alar_status AS "alarStatus" FROM wms_env_monitor_data t WHERE t.id = ( SELECT t2.id FROM wms_env_monitor_data t2 WHERE t2.device_id = t.device_id ORDER BY t2.collect_time DESC, t2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY t.device_id
